paragraphs: I’ve been using iPhone 18 Pro for the past week after a full year as an iPhone Air user. And while there are advantages with each model, my main takeaway about iPhone 18 Pro so far is that it has zero compromises. Here’s what I mean.
If you want to buy a new iPhone, chances are the iPhone 18 Pro is a strong contender.
I’ve had mine for a week now, a Burgundy model that replaced my iPhone Air. And despite loving the Air a lot, it’s hard to match Apple’s no-compromise approach to the iPhone 18 Pro.

I’m not a pro photographer, and if you want battery tests or performance benchmarks, my colleague Chance’s iPhone 18 Pro review has you covered. But after a week with iPhone 18 Pro, that word “best” keeps coming back to me.

iPhone 18 Pro (and Pro Max) pack the absolute best camera system Apple makes, have the best battery life, and perform better than any other models. I’ve even noticed smaller improvements: the better built-in speakers and Dynamic Island upgrades are highlights.

There are measurable differences in all these areas, but I also appreciate just knowing my iPhone has the “best” Apple offers in key areas that matter most. There’s no wondering: would these pictures of my family look better if I used a different iPhone? Would this slowdown have happened?
All the positives of iPhone 18 Pro aside though, I’ll admit that I’m still very intrigued by the forthcoming iPhone Duo.
The iPhone Air and iPhone Duo share a lot in common. Besides having similar design traits, they also both have shortcomings.
